title: D_+(f) meets D_+(g) in the principal open of g^d/f^e
statement: Let $S=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}S_n$ be an $\mathbf N$-graded commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], and $f\in S_d$, $g\in S_e$ homogeneous with $d,e>0$. Let $\iota_f:\operatorname{Spec}S_{(f)}\to X$ be the open immersion with image $D_+(f)$ given by the canonical isomorphism $D_+(f)\cong\operatorname{Spec}S_{(f)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], so that $\Gamma(D_+(f),\mathcal O_X)=S_{(f)}$. Then $\iota_f^{-1}(D_+(g))=D(g^d/f^e)$, the principal open of the element $g^d/f^e\in S_{(f)}$. Equivalently: $D_+(f)\cap D_+(g)$ $(=D_+(fg))$ is the set of $x\in D_+(f)$ at which the germ of the function $g^d/f^e\in\Gamma(D_+(f),\mathcal O_X)$ is a unit of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$, i.e. the basic open of that function in the scheme $D_+(f)$.
